summary: Iteration 3: public landing page, APK-check, routing and email config. Backend: 7/7 pytest passed (public APK endpoint without auth returns exactly kenteken/merk/model/apk_vervaldatum; GZ123X -> Renault Captur 21-06-2027; ZZ999ZZ -> 404; too-long plate -> 400; /api/rdw still requires auth; .env NOTIFY_EMAIL and EMAIL_REPLY_TO = info@merkanic.nl; admin login sets an httpOnly cookie). Frontend: / shows landing (no redirect) with hero, APK section, Klantenportaal section, footer. APK result and error work. All nav links work: Inloggen/portaal-login go to /login, Registreren goes to /login?tab=register with the register tab active ('Account aanmaken.'), login-home-link goes to /, /abc goes to /, and /portaal while logged out goes to /login. Logged-in admin: lands on Werkorders, portal logo goes to /, landing shows 'Naar portaal' on both buttons and hides Registreren, and /login redirects to /portaal. One bug found and fixed: 15px horizontal overflow on mobile at 390px in the APK section.

minor.issue: Public, unauthenticated RDW proxy has no rate limiting (abuse vector, optional hardening)

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED: horizontal overflow on 390px mobile (scrollWidth 405). The grid had no mobile column template, so the auto column grew to the input's intrinsic width (size=20 at text-xl with tracking-widest). Added grid-cols-1 to the APK and Portaal section grids; scrollWidth is now 390 and desktop is unaffected.

issues: Submitting an empty kenteken does nothing silently (no hint). Minor UX gap.

action_items: Optional: show validation hint for empty kenteken
critical_code_review_comments: PortalLayout logo uses <a href='/'> (full page reload) instead of a react-router Link. It works, but it reloads the app.

Old regression suites (test_merkanic_api.py, test_photos_gereed.py) read REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from os.environ and fail at collection unless the env var is exported. Not rerun this iteration, to avoid registration/Gereed emails going to the real info@merkanic.nl.
seed_data_creation: None. No users registered, no emails triggered, S597PJ untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Landing at /, public APK at /api/public/apk/{k}. Use GZ123X (Renault Captur, 21-06-2027) as a known plate and ZZ999ZZ as a not-found plate. Run test_public_apk.py (it reads frontend/.env directly). For the older suites, export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL first; they may send emails.
